title: long time 3d modeler, finally making my 2.5d game thanks to ai coding
author: Fickle_Management597
selftext:
i've been selling 3d models for years and always had game ideas but the programming side always stopped me. recently i started using ai to handle the scripts and it completely unblocked my workflow.



my buddy is doing the 2d illustrations and i am handling the 3d side for a 2.5d adult game. i know there is a solid market for it based on my past asset sales. it feels amazing to finally turn an idea into something playable without getting stuck on syntax errors for days.



are any other artists here in the same boat? coding was my biggest wall. let me know if you guys have tips for keeping the ai context clean when the scripts get larger.

comments.author: ExtensionFun7894
comments.body: Could you share some AI tools that you use to convert 2D to 2.5D?

replies.author: Fickle_Management597
replies.body: Hi. By 2.5D, I meant using 3D models in a 2D environment and background with a fixed camera. But you could also easily render the 3D models' animations to get 2D sprites.
